integrity: The new conditional bound is supported by an analytic mass-splitting lemma; numerical examples are supplementary. Literature comparisons are limited to located and inspected sources; novelty is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Proved for all finite commuting conditional signal states; noncommuting ensembles and general bipartite quantum states remain outside scope. An equivalent theorem might exist under different terminology. Finite numerical checks are not universal proofs.
title: Sharp Bayes-error control of conditional subentropy for commuting ensembles
